description: This file implements console input/output handling for the rusEfi firmware, including serial communication, console loop management, and protocol switching.

classes.name: ts_channel_s
classes.description: Structure representing a console communication channel, including buffer and channel reference.

methods.name: onDataArrived
methods.description: Sets a flag indicating data has arrived on the console input.

methods.name: getConsoleLine
methods.description: Reads a line from the console input stream, handling special characters and echo.

methods.name: runConsoleLoop
methods.description: Main loop to process console input, handle protocol switching, and invoke callback.

methods.name: startConsole
methods.description: Initializes and starts the console interface, including serial port setup and thread creation.

methods.name: consolePutChar
methods.description: Outputs a single character to the console channel.

methods.name: consoleOutputBuffer
methods.description: Outputs a buffer of data to the console channel.

methods.name: switchToBinaryProtocol
methods.description: Switches console communication to binary protocol mode.
